title: Dates, money and text bug hunts
description: Wrenhaven Scores is a two-person publisher of choral arrangements that licenses them to choirs in five countries and bills each one by invoice, and its customers keep finding what the code got wrong: a penny too much, a due date a day early, a name cut in half. You work through five tickets, each a bug that honest JavaScript falls into with a date, an amount of money or a piece of text: catch it with a test, fix it at the cause, and write the test for the case next door. You learn to keep money in whole pence, keep a calendar date a calendar date in any time zone, add months and days the way a calendar does, sort the way a person reads, and cut and compare text by what a person sees.
